record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.original_question: For a countable dense homogeneous continuum, must every open subspace also be countable dense homogeneous, homogeneous, or both?

evidence.quote: Problem 10 (Watson–Simon [94]). Are open subsets of CDH continua CDH? Homogeneous?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A continuum is a compact, connected, metrizable topological space with more than one point. A topological space $X$ is called countable dense homogeneous (CDH) if $X$ is separable and, whenever $D$ and $E$ are countable dense subsets of $X$, there exists a homeomorphism $h\colon X \to X$ with $h(D) = E$. A space $X$ is homogeneous if for any two points $x, y \in X$ there exists a homeomorphism of $X$ onto itself mapping $x$ to $y$.

Question: Let $X$ be a countable dense homogeneous continuum, and let $U \subseteq X$ be a nonempty open subspace. Must $U$ necessarily be countable dense homogeneous? Must $U$ necessarily be homogeneous?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in the 2018 survey "Open problems on countable dense homogeneity" (Hrušák–van Mill). Watson and Simon (Fund. Math. 1992) and Fitzpatrick–Zhou constructed connected, locally connected CDH spaces with non-CDH open subsets, but these constructions are not continua (not compact metric). No resolution for the case of CDH continua appears in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Open subspaces of countable dense homogeneous spaces (Watson-Simon)
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a completely regular connected, locally connected CDH space with an open subset that is not strongly locally homogeneous (has a unique cut-point).
status_evidence.claim: Watson-Simon constructed a CDH (non-continuum) space with a non-homogeneous open subset, but the question for continua remains separate.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity (Hrušák–van Mill)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems on CDH spaces including Problem 10 attributed to Watson-Simon about open subsets of CDH continua.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed as open in this 2018 survey.
